capa-rules.derivation: Data dependency only. script/import-upstream.sh fetches the pinned tree into tools/capa-match/upstream/capa-rules (gitignored); build.rs normalizes every *.yml rule into a compact JSON ruleset, gzip-compresses it, and embeds it via include_bytes!. Malformed rules are counted as parse errors and skipped rather than failing the build. The YAML parser (serde_norway) is a build/test dependency and is never linked into the module.

goblin.derivation: Vendored at upstream/goblin (shared with tools/goblin) because crates.io yanked 0.10.6. Used unmodified for PE/ELF/Mach-O/archive parsing; scroll/scroll_derive/plain are its transitive crates.

flate2.note: zlib-rs 0.6.7 backend for embedded-rules-blob decompression only; no input decompression

derivation: Bounded wasm-bindgen wrapper implementing a static subset of capa rule evaluation: normalized ruleset AST with compile-time constant folding of unsupported features, bounded FeatureSet extraction (strings, byte patterns, PE/ELF/Mach-O metadata), and a memoized evaluator with Aho-Corasick shared scans, regex-backed wildcard matching, work budgets, and count-range semantics. Not the capa engine; reports a lower bound of matches with explicit skipped/degraded/unsupported accounting.
